description: Department of Local Government Eastern Province - Declare that A. M. Nahfar as Chairman of Koralaipattu Pradeshiya Sabha - Batticaloa District
categorisation: This gazette notice announces the election and declaration of a chairman for a local authority (Koralaipattu West Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with electoral results and declarations at the local government level, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7) for electoral processes and related matters.
